text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?
reply_text:
I replied in #inc-vtg-hartford, in your thread.

You first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug. Your message said both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan, and that the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard.

The channel has nothing else on the guard between then and 11:03 AM, when Mateo reported that kiosk 1 was back and the guard had checked in trailer 8836. Both lanes were confirmed working at 11:07 AM. If the postmortem needs more on the guard's activity, it would have to come from the guard or the site, since it isn't recorded in the channel.

text: And mine: which ticket holds the status-page screenshot for Mateo's access problem?
reply_text: @ruth.calloway: The status-page screenshot is attached to ticket INC-4821. Gideon noted that in his 11:08 AM message on 3 Aug. I replied in your thread in #inc-vtg-hartford.
